definitions.gloss: annual salary system; pay set by the year
definitions.explanation: A pay system in which an employee's salary is fixed as a yearly sum, usually by individual contract and often tied to performance, rather than built up from a monthly wage, seniority and bonuses. Standard for professional athletes and spreading among managers and specialists.
